title: Which country has the most islands? It's not Indonesia.
description:
By national counts Sweden has the most islands, 267,570, then Norway and Finland; Indonesia has about 17,500. Sweden counted islands as small as nine square metres.

Sources:
- List of countries by number of islands — Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_number_of_islands
- Sweden's 267,570 islands: the official count — Scandinavia Standard: https://www.scandinaviastandard.com/t-sweden-267570-islands-official-count/
- Which country has the most islands? — Live Science: https://www.livescience.com/what-country-has-most-islands

Labels: national counts use different rules, so figures differ between sources (Norway's ranges from about 55,000 to 239,057). Flags: official SVGs from Wikimedia Commons.
